name: @bushizhanghan/dsh-publish-gate
description: Helps DSH plugin AUTHORS publish their plugins: a one-command gate that turns every silent failure in the publish path into a deterministic check — package.json completeness, BOM, YAML/JSON parseability, junction and patch insert correctness, npm scope permissions, GitHub repo and token state, market entry format, LICENSE/README, test suite. 帮助插件作者一键发布：写完插件后跑一遍门禁，把发布链路上的每个静默坑变成确定性检查，然后 GitHub + npm + 市场一键三连。
author: bushizhanghan
